messages:
Alex C: Quick heads-up: starter-kit CI failing with structured function-calls when transient auth triggers a retry. Schema parse error references trailing characters.
Maria S: Error sample: ValidationError: unexpected token at end of JSON (payload looks like '\"{...\n}\"').
Alex C: Root cause: retry middleware does JSON.stringify on a body that was already serialized by json-mode helper (which appends '\n' delimiter). Retry path ends up sending a quoted string with escaped newline.
Samir P: Fix plan: (1) retry should reuse body if typeof === 'string' or Buffer.isBuffer; (2) signing must use the exact bytes sent (include json-mode newline when present); (3) add unit test asserting signature parity with the Py helper and a 401->200 retry e2e.
Priya K: I'll open a small PR to change retry.ts to reuse payload when already serialized and add the tests. Also adding a sample-app test that stubs auth to 401 once then 200 and verifies Buffer equality of the received body.
ci-bot: PR #4999 opened by priya-k: "ts: avoid double-serialize in retry; sign canonical payload"  https://ci.redwood/p/4999
Alex C: Also add a short migration note in SDK docs: "When using json-mode helpers, middleware/retry logic must not re-serialize the body; preserve raw bytes for signing and schema parity."
Maria S: Will add docs blurb and a minimal repro snippet. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
